sources.shapes: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb, 2020 census tracts
sources.acs: ACS 5-year table-based summary files B19013, B03002, B17001; values are [estimate, margin of error]
sources.places: CDC PLACES releases 2020-2025 (BRFSS 2018-2023), crude prevalence [value, low CI, high CI, tract basis]

breaks.cancer: Definition changed with data year 2022 (adds melanoma). Do not compare 2021 and earlier with 2022 and later.
breaks.places_tracts: Data years 2018-2021 were modeled on 2010 tracts and are area-weighted onto 2020 tracts here (approximate).
breaks.places_model: PLACES is a small-area model; CDC says it cannot detect effects of local interventions or sources.
